name: codex-pdf-previewer
description: Preview local PDFs with continuous scrolling, selectable text and independent high-resolution sampling.

interface.shortDescription: Sharper local PDF previews for Codex
interface.longDescription: Read local PDFs with continuous scrolling, selectable text and independent high-resolution sampling. Bundled PDF.js, 150% default zoom and 3x default sampling. Runs locally on macOS, Windows and Linux with Python 3.10+.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex PDF Previewer to open a local PDF.
